component.title: AsyncFormFlow
component.purpose: A create-or-edit workflow that keeps user input, async state, recovery, and the next navigation step in one trustworthy experience.

states.description: A populated profile flow is ready to validate and save.
Initial data loading is delayed and announced without pretending fields are ready.
Server field errors preserve input and appear in the summary and field context.
Offline data behavior stays explicit and retryable.
A successful save communicates safety and offers the next navigation action.

claims.statement: Validation, server rejection, and cancellation preserve the values the user entered.
Loading, refresh, stale, partial, offline, and request-error presentation delegates to AsyncBoundary.
The flow exposes retry, cancellation, useful server field errors, and an explicit success handoff.
Header controls, fields, and actions remain usable when the surface becomes narrow.
